title: Print the text of the results file
command:
python3 scripts/tenant_pi.py results \
  --overlay "$HOME/.config/tenant-pi/overlay.json" \
  --facts "$HOME/.config/tenant-pi/results-facts.json" \
  --target "$HOME/.pi/profiles/main" | \
  sed '/^## The account/q'
setup: printf '%s\n' '{"schemaVersion": 1, "date": "2030-01-01", "installingAgent": "EXAMPLE_AGENT", "status": "stopped", "lastStage": "Stage 5: generate", "nextStep": "Install Pi, then do the first launch.", "account": {"name": "alex", "createdByInstall": false, "openShell": "su - alex"}, "places": {"node": "24.21.0", "launchers": [{"target": "/home/alex/.pi/profiles/main", "path": "/home/alex/.config/tenant-pi/launch-main.sh"}]}, "stages": [{"stage": "Stage 5: generate", "state": "done", "note": null}, {"stage": "Stage 6: install the dependencies", "state": "not_run", "note": "Pi is not installed."}], "checks": [{"name": "Check 3: the model reply", "state": "not_run", "note": null}], "wikiVault": {"path": null, "existedBefore": false, "kept": false}, "notes": ["The capture container has no network access."]}' > "$HOME/.config/tenant-pi/results-facts.json"
